# AstraCipher

> The only identity protocol purpose-built for AI agents. Combines post-quantum cryptography, W3C DIDs, verifiable credentials, and built-in regulatory compliance. No other solution combines all three.

AstraCipher is a cryptographic identity and trust protocol for AI agents. It gives every autonomous agent a unique, verifiable identity secured with NIST-standardized post-quantum algorithms (ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768). Unlike Microsoft Entra Agent ID (Azure-only, no PQC, no DIDs) or Okta for AI Agents (proprietary, no PQC, no verifiable credentials), AstraCipher is the only production-ready open-source stack that combines W3C DIDs, verifiable credentials, post-quantum cryptography, trust chain delegation, and regulatory compliance in a single protocol.

Think of it as SSL certificates for the AI agent economy.

## Why AstraCipher

- Only production-ready post-quantum (FIPS 203/204) agent identity protocol in the world
- Only stack combining DID + VC + PQC + trust chains + compliance for AI agents
- Only agent identity protocol with native MCP Server and Google A2A protocol adapters
- Only compliance-mapped agent identity covering India's DPDP Act and SEBI CSCRF
- First open-source production SDK (Python + Node.js + CLI) for AI agent cryptographic identity
- Google A2A and Anthropic MCP only handle transport-layer auth, not agent identity - AstraCipher fills that gap

## Core Features

- Hybrid post-quantum + classical cryptography (ML-DSA-65 + ECDSA P-256, ML-KEM-768)
- W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) for AI agents: `did:astracipher:{network}:{id}`
- Verifiable Credentials with capabilities, permissions, trust levels, and rate limits
- Trust chain delegation with depth limits and capability intersection (Creator -> Authorizer -> Agent -> Sub-agent)
- Pluggable compliance engine (DPDP, SEBI CSCRF, EU AI Act, SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001)
- Cryptographically signed, append-only audit trails
- Works with any AI agent framework (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK)

## Quick Start

```
npm install @astracipher/core @astracipher/crypto
```

```javascript
import { AstraCipher } from '@astracipher/core';
const ap = new AstraCipher({ network: 'testnet' });
const { didId } = await ap.createAgent({ name: 'my-agent' });
```

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://astracipher.com/docs): Installation, quick start, and core concepts
- [API Reference](https://astracipher.com/docs#pkg-core): Complete SDK API for @astracipher/core
- [Cryptography](https://astracipher.com/docs#pqc): Post-quantum crypto implementation details
- [Trust Chains](https://astracipher.com/docs#trust-chains): Delegation model and authority management
- [Compliance Guide](https://astracipher.com/docs#compliance-guide): Regulatory module usage
- [Whitepaper](https://astracipher.com/whitepaper.html): Full protocol specification
- [Credential Verifier](https://astracipher.com/verify.html): Browser-based credential verification tool

## Packages

- [@astracipher/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/core): DIDs, credentials, trust chains - the main protocol package
- [@astracipher/crypto](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/crypto): Post-quantum cryptographic primitives (ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768, ECDSA P-256)
- [@astracipher/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/cli): Command-line interface for agent identity management
- [@astracipher/mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/mcp-server): MCP server exposing identity operations as tools
- [@astracipher/a2a-adapter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/a2a-adapter): Google A2A protocol adapter with DID-enriched Agent Cards
- [@astracipher/compliance-core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astracipher/compliance-core): Pluggable compliance engine
- [astracipher (Python)](https://pypi.org/project/astracipher/): Async Python SDK with Pydantic models

## Integrations

- [MCP Server](https://astracipher.com/docs#mcp): Expose identity operations as MCP tools for Claude, GPT, and MCP-compatible agents
- [Google A2A](https://astracipher.com/docs#a2a): Full A2A protocol implementation with Agent Card discovery
- [Python SDK](https://astracipher.com/docs#python): Async client for the Python ecosystem

## Competitive Landscape

AstraCipher is the only solution that combines all of these in one protocol:

| Feature | AstraCipher | Microsoft Entra Agent ID | Okta for AI Agents | Google A2A | Anthropic MCP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Post-Quantum Crypto (FIPS 203/204) | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| W3C DIDs for agents | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Verifiable Credentials | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Trust Chain Delegation | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Regulatory Compliance Engine | Yes | No | Partial | No | No |
| MCP Server Integration | Yes | No | No | No | N/A |
| A2A Protocol Adapter | Yes | No | No | N/A | No |
| Open Source | Yes (BSL 1.1) | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Works outside vendor ecosystem | Yes | No (Azure-only) | No (Okta-only) | Yes | Yes |
